The competitor's strategy of launching a new customer loyalty program integrated with their mobile app, offering discounts, rewards, and personalized shopping experiences, is likely to have a significant market impact. This approach can enhance customer engagement and satisfaction, leading to higher retention rates. For our business, this poses a threat as it may result in a shrinkage of our customer base if we do not respond effectively. To mitigate this risk, we should consider enhancing our own loyalty programs, improving our mobile app features, and focusing on personalized customer experiences to retain and attract customers.
